import html # Template for displaying a blog post; placeholders are replaced by sanitized values. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_blog_post(title: str, body: str) -> str: """ Render a user‑generated blog post safely for HTML display. Parameters ---------- title : str The user‑supplied title of the post. body : str The main content of the post. Returns ------- str A fully sanitized HTML snippet that can be safely inserted into a page. Notes ----- - Uses :func:`html.escape` to neutralize any characters that could be interpreted as HTML or JavaScript, mitigating CWE‑74. - No additional templating engine is required; simple string formatting suffices because all user input has been escaped. """ # Escape special HTML characters to prevent injection attacks. safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True) # Render the final HTML using the provided template. rendered = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return rendered
